headline: The deck is the page
overview: Scroll decks trade slide mechanics for reading mechanics: no controls to learn, no deck that ends before the reader is finished, and a shareable position anywhere in the argument.

steps.title: A deck that opens like an essay
steps.description: A scroll deck has no slide numbers and no next button. The first screen is a full-bleed hero that sets the argument, and everything after it is reached the way a reader already knows how to reach it.
steps.screenshotAlt: The opening hero of the flagship scroll deck

steps.title: The argument begins
steps.description: The first section after the hero states the claim the rest of the deck spends its length defending.
steps.screenshotAlt: The flagship deck partway down, at 1.4 viewport heights

steps.title: Evidence, mid-scroll
steps.description: Sections alternate between assertion and demonstration, so a reader who stops anywhere still has something concrete on screen.
steps.screenshotAlt: The flagship deck partway down, at 3.2 viewport heights

keyFeatures: Scroll-bound sections with no navigation to learn
